command:
"""Normalize Qwen's top-level thinking alias before starting pinned SGLang.

Patch the request schema before imports/spawn so all tokenizer workers use it.
The immutable runtime image and exact anchors bound this compatibility patch;
remove it once the upstream request schema accepts the alias itself.
"""

import importlib.util
import runpy
from pathlib import Path

FIELD = "    chat_template_kwargs: Optional[Dict] = None\n"
NORMALIZER = "    def normalize_reasoning_inputs(cls, values: Dict):\n"
ALIAS_FIELD = "    enable_thinking: Optional[StrictBool] = None\n"
NORMALIZE_ALIAS = '''        # Fleet Qwen compatibility: explicit template kwargs take precedence.
        alias = values.get("enable_thinking")
        if alias is not None:
            if type(alias) is not bool:
                raise ValueError("enable_thinking must be a JSON boolean or null")
            existing = values.get("chat_template_kwargs")
            if existing is not None and not isinstance(existing, dict):
                raise ValueError("chat_template_kwargs must be a JSON object or null")
            values = dict(values)
            kwargs = dict(existing or {})
            kwargs.setdefault("enable_thinking", alias)
            values["chat_template_kwargs"] = kwargs
'''


def patch_source(source):
    # Limit changes to the chat request class, not Responses or completions.
    start = source.index("class ChatCompletionRequest(BaseModel):\n")
    end = source.index("\nclass ", start + 1)
    before, chat, after = source[:start], source[start:end], source[end:]
    if ALIAS_FIELD in chat:
        if NORMALIZER + NORMALIZE_ALIAS in chat:
            return source
        raise RuntimeError("Upstream enable_thinking changed; review the compatibility shim")
    if chat.count(FIELD) != 1 or chat.count(NORMALIZER) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("SGLang chat request schema changed; review the compatibility shim")
    chat = chat.replace(FIELD, ALIAS_FIELD + FIELD)
    chat = chat.replace(NORMALIZER, NORMALIZER + NORMALIZE_ALIAS)
    return before + chat + after


def main():
    root = Path(importlib.util.find_spec("sglang").origin).parent
    protocol = root / "srt/entrypoints/openai/protocol.py"
    source = protocol.read_text()
    patched = patch_source(source)
    if patched != source:
        protocol.write_text(patched)
    runpy.run_module("sglang.launch_server", run_name="__main__", alter_sys=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
